text: You pull the lever and hear a gate opening to the East that appears to be the entrance to the Fire Fiend's lair.

P.S: THE ORIGINAL STORY OF RED CLOUD MUSIC MOD IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH THE REMIX MAP. IT IS RECOMMANDED TO PLAY WITH THE 'The Story of Red Cloud Music - Remix Map Version' MUSIC MOD INSTEAD, AVALIABLE ON THE STEAM WORKSHOP.
You've found the home of the Shaman Elder
Miakoda : In this labyrinthine area, the 4 most powerful armors of the Tavernkeep are scattered, I advise you to find them!

The Eternal Reef is one of the oldest biomes in the world where life has developed in a spectacular way, independently of the rest of the world. --NEWLINE But this exotic fauna and flora makes this reef very dangerous.  --NEWLINE This is also where a huge mutated creature resides, maybe here you will find the place to bait it and fight it on the surface...

Here lived a group of merfolks, a mythical, forgotten aquatic race. They coexisted with the Great Duke in the reef, more or less peacefully. Long ago, when the fiends roamed the lands, the Water Fiend Kraken settled in the Eternal Reef, gradually disrupting and destroying it. It was driven back and fled east deep into the dreamlike caves, but at the cost of their territory, which has long since been in ruins.
- You arrived in the Tropics - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The Tropics are the edge of the known world to the west, renowned for being rich in life but dangerous and filled with ruins...
Miakoda: I heard that beneath these ruins there is a coveted treasure, but be careful, it is full of traps...
You need a large ruby and a large emerald to open the gate. --NEWLINE The large emerald is a treasure long ago left in the tropics...
- You arrived in the Mycelium Forest - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "If I remember correctly, this place is where the Truffle lives..."

"Greetings Red, so you have made it to the western lands. I have guarded this home and this little mushroom forest for a long time, a small paradise and a great oasis between the corrupted mountains of the east and the arid and hostile desert of the west. I am in communication with my friend Yimaya, the Dryad, she informed me of your returns and the path you have traveled, I can only encourage you, but beware, the challenges on your way are only just beginning... your path further east will be difficult. Otherwise, you are welcome here, if rest is necessary."

Before you dive below, you have a sudden feeling of the presence of your wife.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You look to the edges of the lake for any signs of her, but nothing.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I love you my dear," you think to yourself. "I don't know if you're still alive, but I will find you,.. in this life or the next."
You remember the Wizard telling you about this place - that to awaken The Hunter you must dive to the bottom of the lake and touch the golden ring.
- You've found the entrance to the Eternal Reef -
You feel a strong presence coming from behind this Chlorophyte gate,... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I need the Drax..."  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE It feels urgent.
- You've found the lair of The Hunter - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Miakoda: "The lever to unseal the temple gate may be nearby..."

You hear a mushroom making sounds beyond the wall. When it has your attention, it speaks to you.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "After you have prepared yourself, seek the Great Pyramid..." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "An entrance hides in the jungle near the exit of the Obsidian's Volcano.."
You find a note on the table; it's difficult to decipher, but you manage to read this: --NEWLINE Capital... Fallen... Great Demon... lava...

Asha: "Okay, Red. But first I need to tell you where you can find your father's sword and Hallowed armor. It has long been kept in the roots of the Old One's Tree, and the entrance is in the leaves of the tree, at the Dryad's house. The path is sealed with pure Chlorophyte that only the Drax could break." --NEWLINE Red: "Okay, let's go."
Red: "I will come back, and we will finally be able to live in peace. When we get to the surface, I'll take you to the tropics to the West, and I will return there when Attraidies is finished."

"Attraidies has played all of us. But it doesn't matter. I did what I thought I needed to save you." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I believe you Red. My heart aches to think of you leaving again after finding me, but I have to trust you'll come back to me again."

Asha: "What are you going to do?" --NEWLINE Red: "I'm going to kill him. In my quest to find you, I've done a terrible thing, and I have to make right by my father and heal the Earth of this corruption that I helped Attraidies to unleash." --NEWLINE Asha: "What did you do?"

"When I refused to tell them where your father's sword was, Attraidies tortured me for several days, but finally gave up and left me here. I don't know why he didn't kill me. But thank god. It's so good to see you." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Red: "Here, let's get you out of here. I'll take you somewhere you can be safe."

You open the door to Asha's cell, and see her clutching her arm, her clothes bloodied and torn, but her eyes as radient with life as ever. You bring her into your arms and hug her closely, then lean your head back to say, "What did they do to you?"
"Is that you Asha?" --NEWLINE "Oh Red, thank god! I'm here!  I knew you were coming.. I could feel you." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Asha, I love you so much! I'm going to get you out of here."
Did you hear a voice?

Miakoda: "If I remember from my last journey, straight up from here we'll find a way out of this cavern, coming up from below the Western Sea. This path also continues far down below. I do not know exactly what you will find down there, but I can sense our path calls us to it."
You hear crackling embers that sound like it's coming from a fireplace.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Maybe there's a place to rest up here."

A voice speaks to you from beyond the stars: "Seek out the Hallow once more. To its East, you will find the lock that guards an ancient, elemental being... The legends of your people refer to it as... Chaos."
This dwelling seems recently abandoned...

Miakoda: "Now that we can break Chlorophyte Gates, there are three, perhaps four paths we can take. It is up to you to decide. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE There is no ideal path, only the path that is most true to you."

You sense the presence of the Fiend nearby. you feel an air so hot and heavy that it makes you want to faint... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "The passage to the left is blocked, but I think it leads to the Fiend. Perhaps the passage above will find a way to open it."

You come upon a mystic sanctuary which appears to be a memorial to Elengad, the ancient great king of the Desert. You feel a deep feeling of peace in your heart for perhaps the first time since the day your parents died and you lost your wife. A great feeling of love overwhelms you, mixed with great sadness as the thought grabs you. You decide to stay here for a moment longer to reflect on your journey... and to summon all your courage for the path ahead.

- You have found the Tomb of Gwyn, Lord of Cinder - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE To defeat Gwyn, you'll need the power obtained from defeating 7 ancient beings. They are known as Artorias, Water Fiend Kraken, Fire Fiend Marilith, Earth Fiend Lich, The Blight, The Ghost Wyvern Mage, and Seath the Scaleless. To fight Gwyn before this will surely result in death...

Miakoda: "Red, mark this spot on your map.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE I believe this cave under the ocean leads to the Tomb of Gwyn.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Should we ever find a way to open this, we should return here." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You get out your journal and draw a rough sketch of where you are.
"You'll need something to travel through this," Miakoda tells you.

- This gate guards the Forgotten Path to Morgul Feleg - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You get out your journal and write a note: --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Lizard gate in a unknown structure somewhere in the waterways of the Shadow Temple, deep in the darkness..."

- You've discovered the Molten Citadel - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE It is the hottest and most scorching place in the world, with a burning brick fortress and a fiery air. Going to this place without fire protection would be madness...

You've found the Temple of Attraidies --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Once you've obtained a shard from defeating each of the 8 demon-gods, you will need the dark and light shards to power the catalyst necessary to summon Attraidies here. In this chest are the dark shards, it seems that the light shards are kept preciously in the roots of the world tree with glowing golden leaves... The catalyst will weaken Attraidies just enough to give you a chance. --NEWLINE "It's time to end this."
Looking at the bolting system on this gate, you think it must take three switches to unlock.
You have discovered the Basements of the Dark Tower. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Attraidies hides many things in this basement, it seems that a powerful alien is locked in there, somewhere..."

Attraidies was once a human citizen of Orespeak, deeply interested in magic and driven by a thirst for power. While studying the world"s history, he became fascinated by the lost tribe of the Takers, the first to create a bond with the Abyss and establish their dominion and unleash chaos upon all of Terraria, eradicating the animists and the peoples of the Old World. Inspired by the Takers, Attraidies resolved to perpetuate the evil legacy of this tribe and conquer the world with his powerful allies.
- You've found The Dark Tower of Attraidies - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The top of the dark tower is blocked, to unlock the passage you will need to go to the basement of the tower...

On the table, you see a paper that appears to be a map of the known world. You see places you"ve visited, but also others unknown to you, like the Lost Islands to the north, which seem to be an archipelago where the goblins originated, or Dunland south of Makhóčhe, the wild land of the Dunlendings. There"s some writing at the bottom of the map, seemingly written by Attraidies: "Most of the territories on this map are either conquered or in ruins. Absolute victory is advancing. Only Ashenpeak, the remnants of the Orid Tribe, and Tibia are fiercely resisting. I'm preparing something for them, a little game they'll fall for completely; they"re not ready..."
You flip the switch and hear a strange noise coming from above the tower. You should go there.

Three stone pillars... enchanted with magic and impervious to anything.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Whoever blocked this passage clearly did not want anyone getting their hands on the power that must lie inside... Perhaps it is best to leave some things buried and forgotten..." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You notice strange markings above each stone pillar...  <^ --- ^^ --- <<^
You have discovered the realm of the Water Fiend. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Miakoda: "Red. I can sense a powerful being close by... Stay alert. You will need every skill at hand to survive."

The ancient inhabitants of these ruins were called the Noranians, a tropical people who worshipped the sea-god Nora, about whom you have heard many myths. No one truly knows how this civilization fell, but it became a place overflowing with treasure, where pirates from across the sea come to land and plunder the ruins...

- The Nora Sea - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The great sea of the west is known as the sea of storms, tidal waves, and pirates. Renowned for its dangerosity, only a few fools venture there in search of new lands. --NEWLINE Seeing the sea on the horizon, you think of all the lands and civilizations hidden beyond, and you wonder if it is as ruined as it is on this continent.
Miakoda: "This looks perilous, Red. Find a way to protect you from the lava, it"s crucial here.

- You've found the Cavern of Anguish - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I could use the Ice Rod here... --NEWLINE ...or perhaps the Sand Gun would be better... --NEWLINE and maybe a strategic potion or two. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE I need to be smart about this... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE One of my grappling hooks could help too."
"A gold bow? Strange... but perhaps it'll be useful..."

Miakoda: "This is it!  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE To the West beyond this gate we'll find the Path to The Hunter. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The Hunter is a deadly predator, adept at killing her prey swiftly and without mercy... Stay humble, Red."

Elengad's Desert Ruins --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You were once told stories of a people known as the Orspeak, who built their civilization deep below the desert sun, connected by a network of tunnels. No one knows why they chose such a inhospitable place to live, but some believe a mystical energy grows far below this spot.
"This must open from the other side."

- You have discovered the entrance to the Shadow Temple - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Miakoda: "The Destroyer awaits at the end of this path Red. I have heard it is a perilous journey. Let us not lose heart!"
You hear gates opening above and below you. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE After a quick look,  you can tell the path above leads back into the caverns near the Shadow Temple.
Miakoda: "The path forward continues down this way, Maybe there's a lever nearby."

Miakoda translates the rune symbols etched into the statue: --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Look away, but do not fear. A Pocket Mirror is near...  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Enter the Marble cave and seek the glowing light. If you brave each chest, you will soon overcome the final fright."

Miakoda: "A brave soul, who once escaped this place alive, told me there are THREE hidden shortcuts, one on the surface of the temple waterways, one in a cave of horrors, and another almost near the entrance, here, but not quite. I do not know what she meant..."

Miakoda: "Red, I've heard many rumors about the Shadow Temple. It is legendary for its labyrinthian design, which sprawls beyond the gates of the temple, connecting caverns, waterways and corrupted spike chasms..."
There must be a lever nearby.
In the distance you see a large tower in a ruined city emitting a shadow all over the desert...

- You arrived in the Great Desert of Elengad - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Looking back at the temple architecture, Miakoda wonders aloud, "Do you think the direction and alignment of these columns have any significance?"

Miakoda: "These items you sometimes find Red, that appear useless... don't be so quick to assume.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE If it can be crafted into something new with dark souls, it may be worth investigating its hidden potential..."
- You've found the Temple of The Destroyer - --NEWLINE Miakoda: "Stay nimble for this next fight, Red. Evasion will be key..."

- This gate guards the Path to the Dreamlike Caverns, home of the Water Fiend Kraken - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You get out your map journal and write a note: "Lizard Gate at the very west of the Mycelium Forest."
- You"ve found the Dreamlike Caverns - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE As the name suggests, you feel like you"re traveling in a dream...
This room seems strange, you feel something different in it even though it seems ordinary. Also, you hear strange noises coming from the celling...
You activate the lever but nothing happens. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE ...? --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE After a short while you hear a noise in a nearby cavern.
You have found the Skeletron Prime Vault, hidden and long-abandoned in the Shadow Temple.
You come upon a deep dark and corrupted cavern. This place appears to be an abandoned mine and the way to the exit of the Shadow Temple.
Checking your compass and map, you think the path East must lead below the Corrupted Temple. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You can sense a terrible foe in this direction, something you have never seen before.
A voice whispers to you... "Seek the Lost Ruins of Artorias, to the East of the Forgotten City, beyond the sun worshiper's house.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE He is waiting..."
You pull the lever and hear the sound of stone crumbling above you and behind you.
-The path to the West is sealed by Adamantite -
You notice a small switch hiding above the door... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "It seems this dungeon uses trickery to guard its secrets," Miakoda remarks.
Miakoda: "The Triad is legendary for slaying many warriors seeking glory. Do not be foolish. Perhaps we should seek greater power before facing them."
- You've found The Catacombs -

These greyish galleries weren't like this before. It was once a vast swamp, tainted by the necromancy of the Earth Fiend Lich. All that remains of this former great swamp are dead roots and a significant amount of water.

To the West <--- --NEWLINE Scarlet Hill --NEWLINE Mycelium Forest --NEWLINE Elengad's Desert Ruins --NEWLINE Unknown... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE To the East --> --NEWLINE The Twin Peaks of Arazium --NEWLINE The Village --NEWLINE The Rainforest of the Orid Tribe
After this gate is the Witchking's lair, where you feel fear as you see the darkness ahead.
Falling from the hole, you land in a blood-soaked lake. Tough, bloodthirsty creatures lurk there, and won't hesitate to try to devour you underwater...
- This gate opens from the other side - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "It's adorned with Lihzahrd brick... Perhaps the way in is sealed by the same material..."
"It seems people were trying to excavate the gems down here. But they're all gone..."

Holding a shadow scale in your hand, you sense that the hidden-soul form of the Shadow Armor has a powerful ability that will be useful in the jungles that lie ahead. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Ahh, this house has tools for me to craft the Shadow Armor."
This gate opens from the other side.
This gate is sealed by Adamantite, one of the toughest ores on the planet.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I'll have to remember this place when I get something that could break through this."

You sense a dark force seeping into your skin. The smell reeks of rotten earth, decomposing flesh and bile. But the power you feel is immense. Twin gods of the earth - known as the Eater of Worlds -  lay possession of this drowned cavern.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE With a growing lust for power in your heart, you  jump into the waters below.

You feel a warm blast of air shoot up from the slit in the corrupted rock below you.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You can sense that the Eater of Worlds is near. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Inside the gold chest a note is found: --NEWLINE "I left a Cloud in a Bottle and a piece of Shadow armor in the chest down below. I hope it serves you better than it did I."
"It appears the path is blocked by another lever..."
- The path to the West is sealed by  --NEWLINE Adamantite -
- You've found the Sanctuary of the Watchers - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I need something that can break Chlorophyte..."
On this wall, it is inscribed: The eyes of death in their fortress have long observed the actions of humanity. No one, not even those in the depths of the world, is spared their terrifying gaze.
Through the window you have an impressive view to the east at the mountain peak. You can see the Ashenpeak Village and the Sky Temple in the distance, and even a bit of the Jungle.
You've found the Eye of the Sanctum, the great observatory of the Triad.
A voice whispers from the depths: --NEWLINE "The Witchking and Artorias are both protected by a powerful magical shield. Seek the Barrow Blade..."

- This gate guards the Path to the Catacombs, Home of the Earth Fiend Lich - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You get out your journal and write a note: --NEWLINE "Lizard Gate at the bottom of the Great Chasm.  Key to open unknown..."
"The lever to open this seems to be hidden, but I have the Cloud in a Bottle now.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Perhaps it's time to head East, towards the jungles of the Orid Tribe."
This volcanic gate must open from the other side.
"This must be the gate that's controlled by the lever down below."

- You've found the Mouth of the Corruption Temple - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You'll need a running start to cross the Great Chasm, with a speed attained only from the mythical Hermes Boots you read about as a child. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The old woman who was gardening mentioned these might be found in the Earth Temple below the village.

This is it. Upon this titanic altar of ancient darkness, you take out the voodoo idol and raise it high above your head, preparing to cast it into the lava below.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE NOTE: If your first attempt does not succeed, use 3 Guide Voodoo Dolls at a demon altar to craft Aaron's Protection stone and use the stone to resummon The Wall.

-You've discovered the Corrupted Forest - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE The sign reads: "BEWARE: The Eater of Worlds sleeps below this forest." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You take a deep breath.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "This must be the way forward."

You realize that your journey is at a crossroads. --NEWLINE You can attempt to venture farther into the Corrupted Temple's depths to retreive unknown treasures, or you can head back to Ashen Peak Village. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE With the Cloud in a Bottle, new lands to the East of your grave are now possible to explore.
You discovered the secret location of the mythical Hermes Boots! The lost pair which the Eye did not consume..
- You've found Leonhard's Bridge, at the juncture between the Twin Peaks of Arazium -

You drop a glow stick down the shaft and it disappears into the darkness. "Maybe I'll use the Greater Magic Mirror here..." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Greater Magic Mirror: Lets you set a warp point at your location. Obtain it by right-clicking on the Green Glowing Skull nearby.

You found the key that unlocks the Golden Treasure Chest. This Key can only be used to open the Locked Treasure Chest found somewhere in this mountain. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "The hyroglyphs look like they're pointing up."
You should rest. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Using potions may be essential to boost your survival beyond this point.
The Golden Treasure Chest. It needs the Golden Key to unlock.
"My god..."
In the dim glow above,  you can just barely see a gold chest at the top of this room.
The book continues: --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Therefore, when opposing those you meet in battle, victory belongs to the grieving side." - The Tao Te Ching, translated by John C. Wu, Chapter 69

On the table you find a book with a passage highlighted: --NEWLINE "The strategists have a saying: --NEWLINE  I dare not advance an inch, but rather retreat a foot. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE There is no greater calamity than to underestimate the strength of your enemy. --NEWLINE For to underestimate the strength of your enemy is to lose your treasure."
This lever opens the volcanic gate at the bottom of the Great Chasm. It has protected the world above for millennia.
You found the key to the Wizard's private chest.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "But could I really steal from him and live with myself?"
You look up and see a purple glow, but can't quite make out what it is from here.
A voice speaks to you from beyond the wall: "Twin Eater of Worlds sleep at the deepest point of these corrupted caverns, directly to the West of the Great Chasm..."

A gust of fresh air hits your face as you walk out of the cave and relief washes over you. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You remember Bodhi saying that village scouts saw Attraidies' army heading East...  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "If they took Elijah and Asha captive, there's a chance they're still alive..." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "It's time to head East."
"Weird... there's a thick slime on the surface of the water here..."
You feel a darkness coming.
The tunnel has collapsed.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I need to find another way in."
- You have discovered the Crimson Temple - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE A feeling in your gut makes you think it would not be wise to venture farther down this path...
You see hearts on the ceiling, beating unusually powerfully and heavily, prompting you to search for a way to destroy them. "Perhaps this lever is connected to those hearts..."
Miakoda: Red, this liquid has very interesting properties, you should perhaps use it to move forward on your path...

The dreamlike caverns are composed of four realms, each with their own distinct colors and architecture. Glowing mushrooms are known to interact spectacularly with colors, and shimmer, a liquid with special properties that reflects every possible color, is found in abundance in these underground caves, creating these mushroom caves with unusual and shimmering colors, which seem very hypnotizing...

The opulent beast carved into the rock mesmerizes you, its red eyes seeping down, down, down into your subliminal conciousness, reaching into your dreams, planting seeds of nightmares and crumbling your faith. You begin to doubt, to ask yourself if you are really capable of taking this to the end.. Enough! You tear your gaze away and suddenly you awake. Two hours have passed! My god. What powers lie within this beast of a god?

The thought of having so many souls on you makes you nervous.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "I should try to spend what I have when I'm able. Especially once I have a few thousand. I don't want hubris or carelessness to be my last regret."
"These Ironskin and Dangersense Potions should help when exploring the Earth Temple..."
Peering down into the dark chasm, a terrible fear strikes your heart.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE There's no turning back now...
"I wonder what these hieroglyphs mean?"

You remember this place, which seemed rather peaceful. The eastern mountain serves in particular as a natural barrier between the dangerous lands of the west and the village. apart from a few weak creatures and corrupted men, there is no great threat, unlike the mountain of the west.
Try dodging mid-air to reach greater distances or evade attacks after jumping.
- Arazium's Mountain Caverns - --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "Odd. These glowing mushrooms don't seem random..."

A troll-like voice beyond the wall snickers, and then mutters, "Remember to use your dodge roll."  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Its creepy laugh unsettles you.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE When you reply back, you hear nothing but a long silence, which makes you question if you've been underground for too long...
"These caverns may be worth exploring before I head deeper below..."
"Hunter potions.... hmm..."
You flip the switch and hear a faint rumble above and perhaps 500 yards to the East, near the Earth Temple entrance perhaps.

On the wall you read a treasure scouting log: --NEWLINE - Discovered locked chest in newly unearthed ruins in the caverns to the West. The stairs have collapsed, making the ascent dangerous.  --NEWLINE - Had to abandon supplies after Ishmael broke his ankle from a fall. Will return tomorrow to retreive them. --NEWLINE -Glowing Runes suggest a key somewhere in the caverns

To the WEST <<< --NEWLINE Arazium's Mountain Caverns --NEWLINE The Great Chasm --NEWLINE The Corruption Temple --NEWLINE Elengad's Desert Ruins --NEWLINE Unknown --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE To the NORTH WEST ^^^ --NEWLINE The Twin Peaks of Arazium --NEWLINE The Wizard's Abode
"This pressure plate must be hooked up to a timer."
You find a skeleton clutching a map tightly in its fist. It mentions the Wizard's house, with coordinates that seem to be pointing to a basement..."
"With a well-timed mid-air roll I think I can make this..."
You pull the lever and hear a faint rumble above you. The glow of a lantern flickers at the top.
Through the glass window you see the 4th lever...

A kind woman tending to her garden tells you about a mystical pair of boots hidden deep in the temple that lies below this town.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "They were once worn by Hermes," she says. "With those boots he could cross great chasms in a single bound."

Red: "It was the Mindflayer King. He finally got his revenge...and he thought he killed me too..." You pause... silent in thought as you realize the choice you've just made. "I've already gathered my armor, weapons and food and will soon depart." ---- Aaron: "Well.. I see. I'll wish you luck Red. It seems impossible, but..." Aaron turns to the Green Glowing Skull above his bed. "Take this! It's always protected me. Perhaps it can protect you too."
Caves can be entered by standing at the entrance and clicking on the darkness above your head.

Your friend Aaron: "Red!" He stammers, surprised, "They said you were killed!" --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Red: "I know, I can't believe it either. I'm just glad you weren't visiting when they attacked. Almost all of my family..."  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Aaron: "I know Red. I can't believe what they did.. It's.."

You see a teal pressue plate. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Below it, a symbol of the Great Eye is painted on the wall.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE "This must be the way forward. I need to find a way to activate this plate..."
You pull the lever and hear a gate opening to the West.
Reading these messages grants the Story Time buff, which disables enemy spawns. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE It will not affect existing spawns.

Torches: Can be placed to remember where you've been. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Potions: Recommended for ordinary exploration and combat. Hoarded potions are of no use to the dead. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Wood & Stone: For making arrows.
You pull the lever and hear a gate opening to the West.
Cooperative Tool Shop - owned and managed democratically by the community.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You are welcome to use all the tools here as needed.

You have discovered the Sky Ruins of the Empress of Light. --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Long ago, Golem imprisoned the Empress using the great magic of the pyramid, leaving this sky temple to fall to ruin.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE It is said that upon the day that Golem is slain, the Empress shall be freed to return to these sacred grounds.
locationName: SKY RUINS OF THE EMPRESS OF LIGHT

text: Seemingly useless or ordinary items found in chests may hide their true potential. Bring them to a Demon Altar or a Recipe guide to discover their real purpose.
"With a bit more speed I can almost..."
Right click on glowing green skeletons and skulls to discover something.
This chest contains the Wizard's personal possesions and requires a key to unlock. But even if I could find the Wizard's key, could I really steal from him and live with myself?
"It's time to head out.."
"A magic mirror... with an inscription: Take me to a demon altar with one thousand dark souls to reveal my true form."

You see a crack in the wall... --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Note: Adventure Mode in TSORC's mod config options enforces the "no block breaking" rule for the map. However, any block that's 1 width wide can be broken... and some block types have no restrictions at all. If something seems suspicious, go for it!

The Town Well. You see a shimmering speck of light deep within the darkness. The light mesmerizes you, as if you saw yourself looking back into your eyes. A rush of memories from the raid suddenly floods your senses. You see your father taking a knife wound from a cloaked assassin with glowing yellow eyes. You remember him throwing you and mother behind him as three black knights, shrouded in an ashen fog, break into the room. You take a blow and the memory fades...

Many items can be transformed with Dark Souls.  --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE You can take items marked as a "Dark Soul recipe material" to Aaron, the Guide, or inspect it with a Recipe Mod to learn more about its hidden potential.

"It looks like I can safely step on this ashen mud without getting burned." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Miakoda: "The inhabitants of these ruins were known to use Obsidian Stones to protect their feet. If we can make it far enough we may be able to find one."

"Father told us stories about Attraidies... I didn't believe... " You pause, and let out a long breath, "...I will not let him destroy the peace our father gave his life to protecting." --NEWLINE  --NEWLINE Bodhi:"I wish you luck brother. You were always the most skilled in the arts of combat. With the nerve damage in my leg, I would simply hinder your path."

The Rage, a great phoenix of fire and anger; the Sorrow, a cold-water eagle filled with melancholy; and finally, Hunter, the most powerful of the trio, the great vulture, representing the vivacious and fearless nature. These creatures, though imposing, were domesticated and used as weapons by Attraidies and its allies to establish its domination over the world...
Seeing these three torches in this cave, you wonder what their significance is.

The crackling embers of your old home blow in the wind. Your writings and paintings destroyed. Your wife is gone.
